body:
incident-bot: HIGH pager: multiple 503/429 alerts from inference-prod. 429 rate increased to ~11% across api-gateway clusters, p95 latency from 320ms -> 3.8s. First sig at 08:42 UTC. Dashboard: https://redwood.ops/graphs/alerts/2301122334 :rotating_light:

maria: noticing a big rise from tenant=acme-inc; high concurrent streaming requests + long context lengths. p90 token-latency correlated with fquery-worker saturation. :thinking_face:

ashok: confirm logs: ````
[08:42:12] gateway-1 ERROR 503 upstream overloaded tenant=acme-inc route=/v1/generate
[08:42:13] worker-7 WARN kvcache-miss tenant=acme-inc seq=2048
[08:42:14] gateway-1 WARN 429 quota-exceeded tenant=acme-inc
````

maria: quick mitigation plan: 1) apply tenant-level soft ratecap 2) disable noncritical streaming flag for tenant 3) reroute some traffic off busy AZs. Will execute in that order.

ryan: on it. applying soft cap now: `redwoodctl tenants set-ratecap acme-inc --rps 15 --burst 30 --mode=soft`  (running) :computer:

ashok: command returned OK. adding traffic shaping rule on ingress: ````
redwood-ingressctl patch-rule --match tenant=acme-inc --action throttle --rps 15
````

maria: disabling feature flag `stream-prefetch` for acme-inc via feature UI: https://flags.redwood/stream-prefetch -> toggled OFF. :no_bell:

srebot: metric check 08:45 UTC: 503 rate down 70% from peak, 429 down 60%, p95 latency improved to 1.1s. Rolling window: https://redwood.ops/graphs/summary?since=08:30

kate: customer-impact quick take: acme-inc and 5 other tenants saw early retries and increased latency. No data loss, but clients received intermittent 503s. Notifying CS to draft message. cc: @oncall-manager.

oncall-manager: good. start a brief incident page and escalate to L2 if we don't see stable metrics in 20m. Sam, please coordinate handoff at 09:05 UTC if metrics remain noisy. :clipboard:

sam: taking notes for handoff. current runbook steps executed: `set-ratecap`, `shunt-ingress`, `disable-flag`. Next: monitoring, then consider temporary quota cut for highly aggressive keys.

maria: observed one noisy client with abnormal token-length distribution — opened an inquiry with platform-security to rate-limit malformed requests. added ACL to block >100k token sequences. :lock:

ryan: also spun up 2 extra inference workers in us-east-1: `infractl scale inference-prod --zone us-east-1 --add 2` ; health checks green. :rocket:

ashok: live dashboard snippet: ````
-- before mitigation (08:40-08:44) --
503/sec: 38 -> 12
429/sec: 220 -> 85
p95 latency: 3.8s -> 1.1s
-- after mitigation (08:44-08:50) --
503/sec: 4
429/sec: 22
````

srebot: automated incident-bot note: creating summary draft. status -> mitigated but monitoring. tagging severity: Sev3.

kate: CS message draft in #customer-notices: "We observed intermittent errors and elevated latency affecting a subset of requests. We have applied temporary rate limits and disabled an experimental streaming optimization for impacted customers. We are monitoring and will follow up by EOD." :email:

sam: preparing handoff. If metrics hold (429 < 30/sec and 503 < 10/sec) by 09:05 we'll close escalation. Handoff details: steps performed, commands used, feature toggles, affected tenants list attached.

maria: one more note — quota change is soft (429s allowed but traffic smoothed). If we need to be more aggressive, we can flip to `--mode=hard` or path denylist tenant. prefer to avoid hard cut unless SLA customer impacted. :warning:

ryan: thumbs: :thumbsup:  I'm leaving monitoring on the hat. will post again at 09:00 UTC.

srebot: 08:58 UTC check: metrics stable, minor 429 tail from one IP block. Recommend follow-up alert to security ops.

sam: handoff to L2 at 09:05 UTC: paste runbook + commands, and assign to @ashok for deeper log analysis.

ashok: ack, will dig into KV cache pressure logs and correlate with model-hotspot scheduler. Expect initial findings in 30-45m.

oncall-manager: summary for postmortem: root cause likely a sudden spike of long-context streaming requests from a customer; contributing factor: feature `stream-prefetch` increased upstream pressure. Mitigation: tenant soft-cap, disable flag, add capacity. Next actions: 1) quota policy review 2) better telemetry for long sequences 3) consider auto-detect noisy keys for auto-throttling.

maria: closing thread after 09:05 handoff. will follow up with a short incident timeline and any customer-specific notes. :white_check_mark:
